account.delete.confirm: Your account will be deleted and you will be logged out. This can not be undone. Delete your account?
account.delete.description: Your account and your personal details are deleted, and you can not log in anymore. Each school keeps you in its lists marked as deleted, or removes you, by its settings. If a school invites you again later, your account is created again.

settings.classmates.description: What a student sees of the other students of its groups and schedules. A professor always sees all the students of its groups and schedules; a student always sees only itself in the list of the students.
settings.classmates.hide.description: Unchecked: in a group or a schedule, a student sees only itself.
settings.classmates.show: Students see the other students of their groups and schedules
settings.classmates.show.description: Checked (default): in a group or a schedule, a student sees all its students.
settings.removedMembers.delete: Delete the removed members, with their entries in the groups and the schedules
settings.removedMembers.delete.confirm: From now on, a removed member is deleted from the school, with its entries in the groups and the schedules. This can not be undone. Save this setting?
settings.removedMembers.delete.descripti: The student, professor or admin entry is deleted, and the person is removed from its groups and schedules. Nothing is kept: the school will not show that the person was ever there.
settings.removedMembers.delete.short: deleted, with their entries in groups and schedules
settings.removedMembers.delete.warning: This can not be undone: every member removed from now on is deleted from the school, with its entries in the groups and the schedules. The members already kept stay as they are.
settings.removedMembers.description: What happens to a student, a professor or an admin of this school when its role is removed, or when the person deletes its account.
settings.removedMembers.keep.description: Unchecked (recommended): the person stays in the lists of the school, in its groups and in its schedules, marked as removed (its role was removed) or deleted (its account was deleted), so you know what happened with it. If the person is added again, it is active again. You can still delete an entry from its list.
settings.removedMembers.keep.short: kept, marked as removed or deleted
